info.title: NB Bond Auction Service
info.description: Public API for the CBDC tokenization sandbox bond service. Sandbox-scale demo backing the nb-ui reference frontend. See docs/plans/archive/openapi-v2-plan.md for design notes.

tags.name: central-bank
tags.description: Central Bank (Norges Bank) operator surface against the WNOK contract: mint, burn, transfer, allowlist add/remove. Operator-only — entra mode requires an operator App Role and returns 403 otherwise. Sandbox-only.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Operator-only ingestion lifecycle (restart loop, drop-and-rebuild projection). Requires an operator App Role in entra mode (403 otherwise); auth is a no-op in none mode.

ETag.description: MD5 of the response body. Reuse via If-None-Match for cache revalidation.

post.description: Tears down the running ingestion loop and starts a fresh one via the same retry-with-backoff helper used at boot. With `?fromBlock=0`, also drops every table in the central projection list so the rebuild starts from `START_BLOCK`. The bidders, banks, and operation-attempt audit tables are preserved systems of record. Returns once `loopRunning=true` or after a 5s timeout; the operator UI polls `/v1/health` to track the rest of the rebuild.

parameters.name: fromBlock
parameters.description: Set to `0` to drop the projection before restarting (destructive — operator UI gates with a type-to-confirm phrase). Any other value, or absent, performs a plain restart without touching the projection.

200.description: Restart completed within the timeout; payload reflects post-restart state.

ETag.description: MD5 of the response body. Reuse via If-None-Match for cache revalidation.

202.description: Restart accepted; loop is still coming up after the 5s timeout (e.g. chain still unreachable). Poll /v1/health to observe readiness.

ETag.description: MD5 of the response body. Reuse via If-None-Match for cache revalidation.

get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for UI refresh hints. Requires the same authenticated, recognised Entra role as other protected reads. Events contain coarse resource keys only; clients fetch current data through the normal API. There is no event replay.

429.description: Too Many Requests — connection attempts exceeded the global limit.

get.summary: List all bonds with full subtree (auctions, bids, allocations, holders)

parameters.name: testMode
parameters.description: Sandbox-only umbrella "test mode" flag. The operator UI flips this from the top bar; ArgoCD- managed deployments should ignore it. Today `testMode=true` enables: (a) unsealing of bids on auctions still in the BIDDING phase on bond / auction GETs; (b) skipping the API-side end-time pre-check on PATCH /v1/auctions/{id} (close) so the operator can attempt close before the bidding window expires — the on-chain contract still enforces `block.timestamp > metadata.end` and reverts with `InBidPhase()` if the window is open. Future test affordances will plumb through this same flag.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: When true, include soft-deleted bonds in the response. Disabled bonds are hidden by default to keep the operator working list focused. See DELETE /v1/bonds/{isin}.

maturityDuration.description: Maturity in DURATION_SCALAR units. The contract multiplies by DURATION_SCALAR; do not pre-convert.

BigIntString.description: Decimal string representation of a uint256

HoldersBody.description: Body for coupon-payment and redemption operations

size.description: Offering or buyback size in 1000-NOK units

maturityDuration.description: Maturity in DURATION_SCALAR units (years on a real chain; sandbox treats each unit as 60 seconds for fast testing). The contract multiplies by DURATION_SCALAR to derive seconds — do not pre-convert. Required for RATE auctions; null otherwise.

CreateAuctionBody.description: Request body for creating an auction under a bond

status.description: Target status. Only "closed" is accepted today; enum extensible later.

CloseAuctionBody.description: PATCH body for the close transition

approve.description: Approve and submit the selected allocation on-chain.

winningBidIndexes.description: Sealed-bid indexes (each Bid.bidIndex) selected as winners. The server recomputes the allocation over exactly these bids and ignores all unselected bids.

FinaliseBody.description: Approve-only finalisation request. The server recomputes the clearing rate over the selected bids and rejects on mismatch, so issuance cannot silently diverge from what the operator reviewed. Use the durable cancel transition instead of a local-only rejection.

BidIndex.description: On-chain sealed-bid array index identifying this bid within its auction. Stable for the life of the auction; used by the operator UI to address winners at finalisation.

privateKey.description: Optional import of an existing 32-byte hex key. Generated if omitted.

CreateBidderBody.description: Request body for creating a bidder

rate.description: Bid rate (bps). Interpretation depends on auction type — yield for RATE, price-per-100 for PRICE/BUYBACK.

SubmitBidBody.description: Request body for impersonated bid submission. The server builds the plaintext, signs the EIP-712 BidIntent with the stored bidder key, dual-wraps with the auctioneer sealing key, and calls BondAuction.submitBid from the bidder’s wallet.

address.description: Target address (must be on the WNOK allowlist)

WnokTransferBody.description: Body for a transfer from the CB account

name.description: Human-readable bank label. Also derives the GlobalRegistry key ("TBD <name>") and the token symbol.

privateKey.description: Optional import of an existing 32-byte hex key. Generated if omitted.

enableWnokSettlement.description: Add the bank address to the WNOK allowlist so it can hold the WNOK reserve and settle cross-bank. Default true.

CreateBankBody.description: Request body for creating a bank (deploys a fresh TBD contract)

address.description: Target address (must be on the TBD allowlist)

TbdMintBurnBody.description: Body for TBD mint / burn operations

TbdTransferBody.description: Body for a transfer from the owning bank's account

errors.description: Populated for 400 validation failures; null otherwise

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 error body. Returned for every 4xx/5xx response.

wnok.description: WNOK contract address; null when WNOK is not registered in GlobalRegistry

HealthContracts.description: Contract addresses the service is bound to

rpcUrl.description: Sanitised RPC endpoint — protocol://host[:port] only, no credentials or path

chainId.description: EVM chainId reported by the provider, or null when unreachable

head.description: Chain head block number, or null when unreachable

headReachable.description: True iff the backend could read the chain head at the time of this request

loopRunning.description: True once startIngestionLoop() has wired its setInterval

lastBlockProcessed.description: Last block the loop wrote to the projection, or null before the first tick

lag.description: chain.head - ingestion.lastBlockProcessed; null when either side is unknown

pollIntervalMs.description: Configured poll cadence for the ingestion loop

lastTickAt.description: Unix-epoch ms of the last tick (success or failure), or null pre-first-tick

lastEventTxHash.description: Most recent tx hash whose log we ingested; null before any events have been seen this process

consecutiveFailures.description: Count of tick failures since the last success; reset on each successful tick

recentErrors.description: Ring buffer (newest first, max 10) of the most recent ingestion-loop errors. Cleared on a successful restart via /v1/admin/restart-ingestion.

HealthIngestion.description: Runtime state of the in-process ingestion loop

ts.description: Unix-epoch ms when the error was observed

message.description: Error message from the failing tick

code.description: Error code (ethers `err.code`) or class name; null when neither set

RecentIngestionError.description: Single entry in the ring buffer of recent ingestion errors

restarted.description: True when the ingestion loop confirmed `loopRunning=true` within the 5s timeout. False means the loop is still coming up (e.g. chain unreachable); operator UI should poll /v1/health to track readiness.

status.description: Post-restart snapshot of the ingestion-loop state

LiveEventStream.description: UTF-8 Server-Sent Events stream. `changed` event data is JSON with one `changed` array. Allowed resource keys are auctions, banking, bidders, bonds, central-bank, operations, and registry. Comment frames are connection/heartbeat signals. No domain data is sent.

payable.description: True when the projection checkpoint timestamp has reached the next payment and payments remain.

anyOf.description: Block number, or null if not yet mined / unknown.

name.description: Human-readable bidder label, unique per sandbox

privateKey.description: Private key, hex (0x + 64 chars). Returned in plaintext because this surface is sandbox-only.

wnokBalance.description: Current WNOK balance in 1-NOK units. "0" until WNOK is reachable.

md5.description: MD5 of canonical (key-sorted) JSON of this DTO. Server-computed; clients compare as opaque strings for cache validation.

Bidder.description: Sandbox bidder roster entry. The same private key signs transactions, signs EIP-712 bid intents, and acts as the bidder pubkey for the dual-wrap encryption.

name.description: Name the contract is registered under in GlobalRegistry

RegisteredContract.description: A contract registered in the GlobalRegistry (name -> address)

available.description: False when CENTRAL_BANK_PK is unset or the WNOK contract is not registered — endpoints respond 503

totalSupply.description: Total WNOK in existence (minted minus burned), in 1-NOK units

wnok.description: WNOK binding state. Null when WNOK is unreachable.

name.description: Bank whose TBD settles government bond payments

govSettlementBank.description: BondManager.GOV_TBD resolved to a configured bank — the government's bond-payment settlement bank. Null when BondManager is unavailable.

md5.description: MD5 of canonical (key-sorted) JSON of this DTO. Server-computed; clients compare as opaque strings for cache validation.

wnokBalance.description: The address's current WNOK balance; null when the chain read failed.

md5.description: MD5 of canonical (key-sorted) JSON of this DTO. Server-computed; clients compare as opaque strings for cache validation.

AllowlistEntry.description: A single allowlisted address with its live WNOK holding

block.description: Block number, or null if not yet mined / unknown.

address.description: The bank's on-chain EVM address as recorded by its TBD contract (getBankAddress) — always chain truth, never derived from server-side key material

actAsAvailable.description: Whether the API holds a signing key matching this bank address, i.e. whether "act as bank" mutations (mint / burn / transfer / allowlist) can succeed. False when the environment's on-chain bank was not created with a key this API knows

md5.description: MD5 of canonical (key-sorted) JSON of this DTO. Server-computed; clients compare as opaque strings for cache validation.

BankInfo.description: A bank the operator can act as — configured fixture or created from the Banking page. The server holds the signing key; only the address is exposed. Feeds the UI bank selector.

address.description: TBD contract address — the resource id

decimals.description: Always 0 — TBD is denominated in whole units

holders.description: Allowlisted addresses with their TBD balances (sandbox-scale)

md5.description: MD5 of canonical (key-sorted) JSON of this DTO. Server-computed; clients compare as opaque strings for cache validation.

TbdToken.description: A tokenized bank deposit (TBD) — one ERC-20 per commercial bank, allowlist-gated and WNOK-reserve-backed. The same DTO is returned by the list and the single-token GET.

address.description: Owning bank's EVM address — holds admin / minter / burner on this token

TbdBank.description: The commercial bank that owns this TBD token

wnokBalance.description: Owning bank's WNOK balance — the central-bank-money reserve

backed.description: True when the bank WNOK reserve covers the TBD supply (reserve >= totalSupply). Informational only — 1:1 backing is not enforced on-chain.

bankAllowlisted.description: True when the owning bank's address is on the WNOK allowlist — i.e. it can hold the WNOK reserve and settle cross-bank in WNOK. Distinct from government-nomination.

TbdReserve.description: WNOK reserve backing (informational). Null when WNOK is unreachable.

nominated.description: True when a government reserve account is set (enables the gov-reserve mint path)

reserveAddress.description: The government reserve account, or null when not nominated

balance.description: TBD balance in whole units (the contract uses decimals = 0)

TbdHolder.description: An allowlisted TBD holder and its balance. Always read with its parent token.

target.description: Primary resource the operation acted on: ISIN, auction id, address, or bank name

txHash.description: Transaction hash when one was broadcast; null when gas estimation rejected the send before broadcast or the operation spans multiple transactions

error.description: Decoded revert reason or failure message; null on success

detail.description: Small operation-specific payload (amounts as strings, counts)

OperationAttempt.description: One operator-initiated on-chain operation attempt from the persistent audit trail. Failed attempts mostly never reach the chain (rejected at gas estimation), so this trail is their only durable record.

OperationType.description: Operator-initiated on-chain operation recorded in the audit trail

OperationStatus.description: Attempt outcome. REVERTED carries the decoded on-chain reason; FAILED is a transport or validation failure; PARTIAL is reserved for future per-leg settlement outcomes.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the token lacks a role required for this resource (entra mode only). Central Bank and admin endpoints require an operator App Role; banking and other protected endpoints require at least one recognised operator or tester role.

Conflict.description: Operation conflicts with current resource state.

InternalError.description: Unexpected sandbox server error. `detail` contains the thrown message to support technology testing and must not be treated as a production-safe disclosure policy.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required chain or sandbox service state is temporarily unavailable.

bearerAuth.description: Microsoft Entra ID access token. In deployments where NB_BOND_API_AUTH_MODE=none (local sandbox default), the header is accepted but not validated. In entra mode the token must carry a recognised App Role in its `roles` claim (see the 403 response); Central Bank and admin endpoints require an operator role.
